Financing FAQs

Will applying affect my credit score?

Initial applications use a soft credit check and will not impact your score. If you accept an offer, a hard inquiry may be performed by the lender.

Can I pay off early?

Yes. Most plans allow early payoff with no prepayment penalties. Terms vary by lender — we’ll outline details clearly in writing.

What do I need to apply?

Basic identity information and estimated project amount. Decisions are typically instant.

All financing is provided by third-party lenders. Terms and conditions apply. Offers subject to change and credit approval.
